Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM Team 1) to 
CIMT (RM Team 2) will occur today. CIMT is also managing the Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles 
northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Moderate fire behavior with uphill runs, flanking and 
group torching. Numerous structures threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Moderate fire behavior with uphill runs, flanking and group torching. Energy infrastructure 
threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
310, Garfield County. One mile east of Battlement Mesa, CO. Brush, timber and dormant brush. Moderate fire 
behavior with running, flanking and backing. Numerous residences and critical infrastructure threatened. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active 
fire behavior with flanking and smoldering. Numerous structures threatened. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
backing and creeping. Communication infrastructure threatened. Area closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Communication infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect.
